settings.title: What's included
settings.content: A four-sided vertical bar necklace and a rectangular split-ring keychain—one to wear and one to carry—with coordinated engraving layouts.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter one verified coordinate pair or customize the necklace and keychain separately. 2. Review every active necklace side and the keychain line in the set preview. 3. Check both submitted engravings in the cart before checkout.

settings.atc_label: Add to cart — free engraving on every piece
